title: Screen visitors through a receptionist proxy
description: Executive is busy and only meets visitors with an appointment. ReceptionistProxy sits in front of Executive and checks a visitor's name against an appointment list before allowing the meeting. Visitors without an appointment are turned away with a polite refusal. Implement ReceptionistProxy to enforce this without changing Executive.
hints: ReceptionistProxy implements the same Person interface as Executive
Keep a Set of approved visitor names; addAppointment() adds to it
meet() checks the visitor name — delegate to executive only if they have an appointment
issues: Without a proxy, Executive must manage its own appointment book inside meet(), mixing business logic with scheduling
Adding a waiting-room or screening step later requires modifying Executive directly
overallGoal: Use the Proxy pattern to let ReceptionistProxy control access to Executive, so Executive only ever sees pre-approved visitors.
goals: Visitors with an appointment are passed through to Executive.meet()
Visitors without an appointment are refused before reaching Executive
ReceptionistProxy implements the same interface as Executive
